shared UserQuery = let Source = #"p_schoolsupdate_s",
    Replace_Status_Active = Table.ReplaceValue(Source, "Active", "301220000", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"school_status"}),
    Replace_Status_NotActive = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_Status_Active, "Not 301220000", "301220000", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"school_status"}),
    Replace_Status_Duplicated = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_Status_NotActive, "{""id"":5,""name"":""Duplicated or created in error"",""c", "301220004", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"school_status"}),
    Replace_Status_ExitedYr1 = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_Status_Duplicated, "{""id"":2,""name"":""Exited During Year 1"",""created_at""", "301220001", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"school_status"}),
    Replace_BreakEvenFee = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_Status_ExitedYr1, null, 0, Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"break_even_fee"}),
    Replace_ECDStartDate = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_BreakEvenFee, null, "", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"ecd_start_date"}),
    Replace_NumClassrooms = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_ECDStartDate, null, "0", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"number_of_classrooms"}),
    Replace_AgreementType_Null = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_NumClassrooms, null, "", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"agreement_type"}),
    Replace_AgreementType_Empty = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_AgreementType_Null, "", "None", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"agreement_type"}),
    Replace_LearnerCapacity = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_AgreementType_Empty, null, "0", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"learner_capacity"}),
    Add_Importschool = Table.AddColumn(Replace_LearnerCapacity, "Importschool", each true, type logical),
    Add_ImportschoolDone = Table.AddColumn(Add_Importschool, "Importschooldone", each false, type logical),
    Add_CountryId = Table.AddColumn(Add_ImportschoolDone, "countryid", each 710),
    Add_TriggerUpdate = Table.AddColumn(Add_CountryId, "triggerupdate", each "update", type text),
    Select_Columns = Table.SelectColumns(Add_TriggerUpdate, {"address","agreement_type","break_even_fee","capacity","city_id","contract_start_date","countryid","ecd_code","id","Importschool","Importschooldone","monthly_salaries","name","number_of_classrooms","owner_id","region_id","school_commencement_date","school_id","school_status","segment"}),
    Rename_1 = Table.RenameColumns(Select_Columns, {{"address", "tcbgrow_Address"},{"agreement_type", "tcbgrow_PaymentType"},{"break_even_fee", "tcbgrow_BreakEven"},{"capacity", "tcbgrow_Capacity"},{"city_id", "tcbgrow_ImportCityId"},{"contract_start_date", "tcbgrow_AppAccountCreationDate"}}),
    Dup_ContractDate = Table.DuplicateColumn(Rename_1, "tcbgrow_AppAccountCreationDate", "tcbgrow_ContractDate"),

    Rename_3 = Table.RenameColumns(Dup_CountryId, {{"ecd_code", "tcbgrow_ImportECDCode"},{"id","tcbgrow_AppID"},{"Importschool","tcbgrow_SchoolImport"},{"Importschooldone","tcbgrow_SchoolImportDone"},{"monthly_salaries","tcbgrow_MonthlySalaries"},{"name","tcbgrow_Name"},{"number_of_classrooms","tcbgrow_NumberofClassrooms"},{"owner_id","tcbgrow_ECDOwner.tcbgrow_AppId"}}),
    Dup_SchoolOwnerId = Table.DuplicateColumn(Rename_3, "tcbgrow_ECDOwner.tcbgrow_AppId", "tcbgrow_ImportSchoolOwnerID"),
    Rename_4 = Table.RenameColumns(Dup_SchoolOwnerId, {{"region_id","tcbgrow_ImportProvinceId"},{"school_commencement_date","tcbgrow_CentreStartDate"}}),
